subject: Mid-quarter pulse: runway & dependency asks
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Mid-quarter pulse: runway & dependency asks

Team —

Quick mid-quarter pulse and a set of concrete asks as we prepare QBR artifacts. I consolidated the latest metrics into the attached dashboard (midq_okr_dashboard.png). High-level status below; please review and call out blockers/needs by EOD Friday so I can fold into the leadership readout.

OKR Snapshot (end of week):
- OKR 1 (Serving runtime throughput): 62% of target — load test showed a persistent tail at 99th pct for seqlen>1024.
- OKR 2 (Dedup + cache improvements): 40% — integration work deeper than expected; depends on infra KV eviction change.
- OKR 3 (Managed rollout + SLAs): 78% — on track, but need legal signoff on updated SLA wording for Dedicated customers.

Asks:
1) Infrastructure (Aditya): we need the KV eviction patch (PR #542) promoted to staging and a one-hour maintenance window on 7/20 to validate. Can you confirm owner and ETA?
2) Platform (Lauren): given the dev time required on KR2, propose we reduce the target for KR2 feature set for the QBR snapshot and focus on the core caching behavior. If you agree, let me know which KPIs to drop.
3) Commercial (Vivek/Monica): I want a short summary of any customer-impacting risks (BrightLeaf is currently on trial with a POC) so we can include mitigation language.

Docs/Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cQBR-pulse-plan (QBR draft)

Please reply with one-line commitments (owner + ETA) so I can produce the slide.

Thanks —
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Group PM, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter pulse: runway & dependency asks

On Tue, Jul 14, 2026 at 9:15 AM Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick mid-quarter pulse and a set of concrete asks as we prepare QBR artifacts...

Thanks for the concise roll-up, Rohan. I agree we should narrow KR2 for the QBR snapshot to the core caching behavior and defer the broader dedup workflow to the next quarter.

Suggested re-scope for KR2 (QBR snapshot):
- Keep: consistent prefix/KV caching, correctness tests, perf baseline for common seqlen (<=512).
- Drop for QBR: multi-tenant eviction policy refinements, UI admin toggles (defer to next cycle).

I'll own the trimmed KR2 scope and will update the OKR doc with revised metrics by EOD Thursday. Aditya — I need confirmation you can prioritize the KV eviction patch for staging by 7/20; if not, we need an alternate mitigation plan (feature flag + conservative defaults).

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Platform PM

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: eng@atlascloud.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter pulse: runway & dependency asks

Looping in Atlas contact for infra-side options — Atlas told us last week they can fast-path the eviction patch into a canary host if we provide the definitive test vector.

Commitments:
- Aditya: please coordinate with Atlas and surface the exact test vector by Monday 7/19. If Atlas can canary the patch, we can validate without an org-wide maintenance window.
- Commercial: I'll prepare a short customer note for BrightLeaf explaining the mitigation steps and proposed timeline (will share draft for approval).

Risks: BrightLeaf has an internal perf window next week; we should aim to have a canary result before their review. Monica — confirm whether we need a controlled rollback playbook for their POC.

-Vivek
VP, Sales & GTM

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter pulse: runway & dependency asks

Thanks — quick summary and final asks below (for the QBR slide deck):

Consolidated asks (action owners + ETA):
- Aditya: provide test vector + coordinate Atlas canary by 2026-07-19 EOD (attachment: infra_dependency_matrix.xlsx).
- Lauren: updated OKR doc with trimmed KR2 metrics by 2026-07-16 (received) — I'll pull those numbers into the QBR deck.
- Vivek: customer-facing mitigation note for BrightLeaf by 2026-07-17 (draft attached: QBR_slide_draft.pptx).

Attachments: canary-plan.pdf (playbook), QBR_slide_draft.pptx (deck draft), infra_dependency_matrix.xlsx

I'll merge these into the QBR draft and schedule a 30-min leadership prep on 7/21 at 10:00am PT — please accept the calendar invite if you can make it. If anyone needs a different time, flag it now.

-Monica
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
